sentences.en: This scenery carries me back to my old native town.
sentences.zh: 这景色让我想起了我的故乡。

sentences.en: I never watch this scenery without thinking of my grand-father.
sentences.zh: 每次看到这景色我都会想起我的祖父。

sentences.en: Guilin's sceneries are the most beautiful ones under the heaven.
sentences.zh: 桂林的风景是天下最美的。

senses.zh: 风景，景色,舞台布景,风景画,舞台面

mnemonic: 词根记忆：scen(e)（景色）+ery（场所）→景色；舞台布景
